name: @tesle/website
description: Tesle — AI-native enterprise software for African businesses
author: Tesle

scripts.dev:electron: npm run compile:electron && vite & sleep 2 && electron .
scripts.build:electron: vite build && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs
scripts.build:electron:mac: vite build && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --mac
scripts.build:electron:win: vite build && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win
scripts.build:electron:linux: vite build && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --linux
